name: Adrados (Spain)
description: Red field with a triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the fly, wavy of white and blue.
history: Adrados adopted its arms and flag officially on 28 April 2003; the arms are wavy of azure and argent, vested in a lozenge gules with a pine and an oak.
